final: WITH g AS (SELECT q.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY q.arcref, p.fundflux), f AS (SELECT fundflux, SUM(cnt) AS s FROM g GROUP BY fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM f) SELECT f.fundflux, f.s, CAST(f.s AS REAL) / t.total FROM f JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
